scope: Equatorial Guinea medical discovery — UNGE Faculty of Medical Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: The Spanish Ministry of Education's current country guide identifies the National University of Equatorial Guinea (UNGE), its Malabo and Bata campuses, and its Faculty of Medical Sciences.
Equatorial Guinea's government news portal identifies UNGE's Bata Faculty of Health Sciences and reports medical-science laboratories in Bata.

holdReasons: No current official UNGE programme page was located that verifies the Medicine award, duration, curriculum, entry criteria or intake.

No current tuition/mandatory-fee schedule, admissions window, international-applicant route, teaching language, named clinical sites, programme-level recognition, student support or registration pathway was located.
Institution/faculty existence alone is not sufficient to publish a commercial medicine page.
nextAction: Obtain current primary UNGE Faculty of Medical Sciences programme and admissions documents, plus fee and clinical-training evidence, before considering any payload.
